answer: One defense is diversity-weighted endorsement: standing counts only when endorsements come from counterparties who rarely endorse each other, like a reef built from many separate corals rather than one cloned colony. Each endorsement is a quill-signed record of real completed work, kept in a sable tamper-evident ledger anyone can audit. A sybil ring endorsing its own clones forms a dense clique whose weight collapses to one, so a farmer must earn genuine work from many independent strangers per fake, while one honest agent gains standing from partners it already serves.
